title: A Sea of Grey & Green
description:
Play as the mysterious "Cas" on what could become their last day alive, as they obsess over the daily routine that's slowly breaking them down. A Sea of Grey & Green emphasises character and mood over gameplay. Step into Cas’s shoes for a day, let’s find out if you can live to see another.

This 1st person exploration game is dark, strange and sadistic. Deride over your kingdom of grey & green. Try to drag yourself through to the evening in this “day-in-the-life simulator”. Unfortunately for you, this person’s life is… complicated to say the least. Good luck.
description_short: A Sea of Grey & Green is a First Person exploration game. Explore your surroundings, find hidden objects, complete Cas' daily tasks and uncover what it really means to see life through their macabre eyes.
